test_title: PYST 31: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The share of ULIPs in the total APE of which insurance company fell to 46.8% in Q1 FY26, compared to 51.4% in the same quarter last year?

options.text: Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance Co. Ltd.
Axis Max Life Insurance Co. Ltd.

solution:
The correct answer is __**ICICI Prudential Life Insurance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The share of **Unit Linked Insurance Plans (ULIPs)** in the total **Annualized Premium Equivalent (APE)** for **ICICI Prudential Life Insurance** witnessed a decrease to **46.8%** during the **first quarter (Q1)** of **FY26**.
 
• This is a notable decline from the **51.4%** share recorded in the **same quarter of the previous financial year (Q1 FY25)**, indicating a shift in the company's product distribution strategy. ***Hence, the correct answer is ICICI Prudential Life Insurance.***
 
• The reduction in **ULIP** concentration suggests a strategic move by the insurer to diversify its portfolio by increasing the focus on **non-linked savings** and **protection** products.
 
• **ICICI Prudential** has been actively rebalancing its mix to mitigate risks associated with equity market volatility, which directly impacts the demand and performance of **market-linked products** like **ULIPs**.
 
• Despite the lower share of **ULIPs**, the company continues to maintain a strong market position by leveraging its multi-channel distribution network, including **bancassurance** and **agency** channels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Annualized Premium Equivalent (APE):**

 
 
• **APE** is a standardized measure used by the insurance industry to compare sales across different periods. It is calculated as the **sum of 100% of regular premiums** and **10% of single premiums** received during the year.
 
• It helps analysts and investors understand the growth trajectory of an insurance firm regardless of the premium payment frequency chosen by customers.
 
 
 
• **Unit Linked Insurance Plans (ULIPs):**
 
 
• A **ULIP** is a financial product that offers a combination of **insurance** and **investment**. A portion of the premium is used for life cover, while the remainder is invested in **equity, debt, or hybrid funds**.
 
• These plans are subject to **market risks**, and the **Net Asset Value (NAV)** fluctuates based on the performance of the underlying assets.
 
 
 
• **ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited:**
 
 
• It is a joint venture between **ICICI Bank Limited** and **Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited**.
 
• The company commenced its operations in **2001** and was the **first private sector life insurer** in India to be listed on the **National Stock Exchange (NSE)** and **Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)** in **2016**.
 
• It is headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
 
 
• **Regulatory Oversight:**
 
 
• The insurance sector in India is regulated by the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)**, which was established under the **IRDA Act, 1999**.
 
• **IRDAI** ensures the protection of policyholders' interests and regulates the **solvency margins** and **investment norms** for insurance companies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Leadership:** As of recent filings, **Anup Bagchi** serves as the **Managing Director & CEO** of **ICICI Prudential Life Insurance**.
 
• **Value of New Business (VNB):** This is a key metric for life insurers that represents the **present value of future profits** expected from the new business written during a specific period. A diversified product mix often aims to improve the **VNB margin**.
 
• **Solvency Ratio:** It is a measure of an insurance company's ability to meet its long-term claims. **IRDAI** mandates a minimum **solvency ratio of 150%** to ensure financial stability.
 
• **Market Trends:** The shift away from **ULIPs** toward **guaranteed return plans** often occurs when interest rates are favorable or when investors seek **capital protection** over high-risk market returns.
